name: Bamboo Shoots
siboNotes: Bamboo shoots are naturally low FODMAP and well-tolerated for SIBO. Their fiber content may provide gentle prebiotic benefits without triggering symptoms.
preparationTips: Rinse canned bamboo shoots thoroughly to remove excess sodium
Fresh bamboo shoots require boiling for 20-30 minutes to remove bitterness
Add to stir-fries in the last few minutes to maintain crunch
Store opened canned bamboo shoots in water in the refrigerator for up to 1 week
nutritionalHighlights: High in fiber for digestive health
